# Fernhill Tea Co. Customer Care and Shop Opening Hours

## Customer care

Our customer care team answers email and phone from Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 CET, and on Saturday from 10:00 to 14:00 CET. We are closed on Sundays and Austrian public holidays. Emails that arrive outside these hours are answered on the next working day.

The customer care phone line is +43 1 555 0142.

## Tasting room in Vienna

Our tasting room at Kirchengasse 14, 1070 Vienna, is open Tuesday to Saturday from 10:00 to 18:00. It is closed on Sundays, Mondays and Austrian public holidays. Online orders can be picked up at the tasting room free of charge during its opening hours, from the business day after the order confirmation email.
